name: Cherry Picker
tagline: The roof inspection that doesn't need a roof visit.
positioning: Autonomous drone inspections for owner-operators who'd rather not climb a 40-foot ladder to photograph the same missing shingle twice.

hero.h1: Inspect the roof. Skip the ladder.
hero.sub: Cherry Picker flies the inspection, tags the damage, and hands your crew a client-ready report before the coffee's cold. No harness. No hospital bills.

features.title: Flights that plan themselves
features.description: Draw a box around the property. We plot the grid, dodge the chimney, and capture every square foot at inspection-grade resolution. You just watch.

features.title: Damage it actually finds
features.description: Cracked flashing, lifted shingles, pooling water. Our model flags them, drops a pin, and stops you from re-flying the same roof to double-check.

features.title: Reports clients don't argue with
features.description: Branded PDF, annotated photos, measured square footage. Export to your CRM or hand it over on-site. Signed before you pack up the drone.

features.title: One dashboard, every job
features.description: Track flights, revisions, and invoices per property. No more sifting through 400 unlabeled JPEGs named DJI_0042.

features.title: Weather won't ambush you
features.description: We watch wind and light windows for your zip code and nudge you when it's safe to fly. Fewer aborted trips to the site.

features.title: Compliance without the paperwork
features.description: Flight logs, airspace checks, and Part 107 records stored automatically. Pull them up when someone official asks nicely.

testimonials.quote: I quoted four roofs before lunch without touching a ladder. The report looked so official my client thought I hired an engineer. I did not.
testimonials.name: Dwayne Ferro

testimonials.quote: We used to bill a full day for one commercial inspection. Now it's 20 minutes of flying and 10 of coffee. Same invoice. Nobody's complained.
testimonials.name: Priya Nadkarni

testimonials.quote: The damage tagging caught a soft spot I'd have walked right past. Saved me a callback and a very awkward phone call three weeks later.
testimonials.name: Marcus Cole

homepage.footerBlurb: Cherry Picker flies, tags, and documents property inspections so owner-operators can keep both feet on the ground and both eyes on the invoice.
